content.text: I'll search for information about cost leaks in the support feature.

input.query: support feature cost leak root cause

content.text: The search returned schema information but not specific root cause details. Let me query the margin data to identify cost leaks in the support feature.

input.sql: SELECT margin_date, tenant_id, feature_id, ai_revenue_usd, llm_cost_usd, cost_to_serve_usd, gross_margin_usd, gross_margin_pct, request_count FROM fct_tenant_margin WHERE feature_id LIKE '%support%' OR feature_id LIKE '%F1%' OR feature_id LIKE '%F2%' ORDER BY margin_date DESC, gross_margin_pct ASC LIMIT 50
